note: Triennial election of Coleraine Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Only Kilrea was contested; Boveedy is the one other division whose new member is named in the reports read. The other eighteen members were returned unopposed but are not individually listed in the sources consulted. Ballylagan and Lislea added from the annual meeting of the new council (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Only Kilrea was contested in 1964 ('a contest for only one of the 20 seats on Coleraine Rural - in Kilrea', Belfast Telegraph, 20 May 1964, p. 4); the other members were returned unopposed but are not named in the reports read. Division inferred from the 1 June 1961 return (G. A. McIlrath, Irish News, 1961-05-17, p. 7); the Belfast Telegraph names the member at the annual meeting of the new council. No co-option or by-election in this division was found. Returned unopposed.
